raw_segments.text: He lifted the hangings from the wall, uncovering the second door.
In a room without a window, there burnt a fire guarded by a high and strong fender and
a lamp suspended from the ceiling by a chain.
Grace Poole bent over the fire, apparently cooking something in a saucepan.
In the deep shade at the farther end of the room, a figure ran backwards and forwards.
What it was, whether beast or human being, one could not at first sight tell.
It groveled seemingly on all fours.
It snatched and growled like some strange wild animal.
But it was covered with clothing and a quantity of dark, grizzled hair,
wild as a mane, hid its head and face.
